title: Pay contribution
unavailableBody: Contribution details are unavailable right now.
handPaymentNotice: Pay one hand at a time. Paying one hand never covers another.
handsUnavailable: Your active hands were not found for this circle.
submittedBody: {{hand}}: waiting for the organizer to confirm receipt. This payment is not confirmed yet.

rails.payInBody: Payment happens here. Confirmation comes from the payment provider.
rails.payOutsideBody: Send using the organizer's instructions, then mark as sent. The organizer verifies receipt.
rails.markAsSentMeaningTitle: What does Mark as sent mean?
rails.markAsSentMeaningBody: This reports that you already sent the payment. CircuSave does not transfer money when you mark it as sent. The organizer must verify receipt before it counts as confirmed.
rails.expandMeaning: Show what Mark as sent means
rails.collapseMeaning: Hide what Mark as sent means

paymentSuccessBody: {{hand}}: payment was submitted and awaits server confirmation.
paymentPendingSettlementBody: Payment received. Confirmation may take a moment. Pull to refresh.

workspace.dueBody: Your {{amount}} contribution is due this round.
workspace.confirmedBody: Your contribution for this round is confirmed.
workspace.pendingBody: Your payment is waiting for the organizer to confirm.
workspace.circuSaveDoesNotSend: CircuSave does not send this payment. Send it using the payment method provided by the organizer.
workspace.organizerVerifiesAfterReport: The organizer verifies it after you report it.
workspace.markAsSentEducation: Mark as sent reports a payment you already sent. CircuSave does not move the money. The organizer must confirm receipt.
workspace.payOutsideAlsoInApp: You can also pay in CircuSave on the next screen if that option is available.
workspace.instructionsFallback: Contact the organizer for payment details.
workspace.instructionsMissingTitle: Payment instructions haven't been provided yet.
workspace.instructionsMissingBody: Your organizer still needs to say where to send this contribution. Cash or in-person payment may still be possible.
workspace.reportedBody: Waiting for the organizer to confirm receipt.
workspace.reportedNotConfirmed: This payment is not confirmed yet. The organizer must verify receipt before it counts toward the round.
workspace.confirmedExplainer: This contribution is confirmed and counts toward the round. It does not mean the payout has been released.
workspace.rejectedExplainer: Review the organizer's instructions and report the payment again if you have already sent it.

review.confirmBody: This means you verified the money arrived. CircuSave will then count this contribution.
review.didntReceiveBody: This reports that you did not receive the money. The member can mark it as sent again.
review.recordPaidBody: Record that you received this outside CircuSave.
review.recordPaidHelper: Record that you received this outside CircuSave

organizerInstructions.title: Contribution payment instructions
organizerInstructions.membersSee: Members see these instructions when their contribution is due. This is how they send money outside CircuSave — not Settings → Payment Preferences.
organizerInstructions.emptyBody: Members may not know where to send outside-app contributions such as Zelle, Cash App, Venmo, or cash.

markAsSent.confirmBody: This reports that you already sent {{amount}} outside CircuSave. CircuSave does not transfer money when you mark it as sent. The organizer must verify receipt before it counts as confirmed.
markAsSent.selectDestinationBody: Select the destination you sent this payment to, then mark it as sent.

alerts.recordedPending: Payment was recorded as submitted, but could not be auto-confirmed. Confirm receipt when ready.
alerts.reminderSentBody: An app notification was sent to {{name}}.
alerts.sendReminderBody: How would you like to remind {{name}}?

reminderMessage: Hi {{name}}, this is a friendly reminder about your contribution for {{circle}}. Let me know if you need help.

paymentSetup.title: Contribution payment instructions
paymentSetup.explainer: Tell members how to send their regular contribution outside CircuSave. They see this when a payment is due. CircuSave does not send this money.
paymentSetup.notPayoutPreferences: This is not Settings → Payment Preferences. Those Cash App, Venmo, and PayPal handles are only for receiving a susu payout.
paymentSetup.maxDestinations: You can add up to {{count}} destinations.
paymentSetup.requiredBody: Add at least one destination so members know where to send payment.
paymentSetup.savedBody: Payment instructions were saved to your circle.
